title: Valorant Tournaments India: Revenant Xspark 2027 Roster
description: Valorant tournaments India fans have a new team to watch: Revenant Xspark unveiled its 2027 VCT roster with three new players, per IGN India.

body.text: Revenant Xspark has unveiled its roster for the 2027 season, giving Valorant tournaments India fans a fresh team to follow, according to IGN India. The five-player line-up mixes three new signings with two players kept from last season, and it has a clear schedule: a debut at the Acer Predator League India 2027, then the VCT 2027 Kickoff Qualifiers.

Hellff, DC and Lightningfast are the three new faces, per IGN India. All three were part of the team that won VALORANT Challengers South Asia Split 2 in 2026 under the No Salary Peek banner. That team then went on to play the Pacific Last Chance Qualifier.
Lightningfast also has experience with Global Esports and Velocity Gaming, covering both regional and international stages. Hellff will take over as the team's in-game leader.
Venka and Hoax, who joined the roster in February this year, are staying. IGN India notes both contributed to a runner-up finish in Split 1 of the 2026 season.
What this means for Valorant tournaments India in 2027

The retained pair gives the team some continuity, while the new trio arrives as recent title winners in South Asia. All five players have also represented India at the Esports Nations Cup 2026 Asia Qualifier, so they have played together on a national stage.
The early calendar is simple to follow:

items: Acer Predator League India 2027: the roster's competitive debut
VCT 2027 Kickoff Qualifiers: the next step after that

body.text: BGMI changes at the same organisation

The Valorant news is not the only shake-up at Revenant Xspark. IGN India reports that the organisation also made major changes to its BGMI line-up. Tenzin "Shadow7" Kelsang returns to lead that roster.

The first real test comes at the Acer Predator League India 2027. Watch how Hellff settles into the in-game leader role and how the new players fit with Venka and Hoax. The VCT 2027 Kickoff Qualifiers will then show whether the roster can turn its recent Challengers success into a stronger run. IGN India's report did not give dates for either event, so check the official event pages for schedules.

faqs.q: Who is on the new Revenant Xspark Valorant roster for 2027?
faqs.a: According to IGN India, the roster has three new players, Hellff, DC and Lightningfast, plus retained players Venka and Hoax. Hellff will be the in-game leader.

faqs.q: Where will Revenant Xspark play first in 2027?
faqs.a: IGN India reports the roster will make its competitive debut at the Acer Predator League India 2027. After that, it will compete in the VCT 2027 Kickoff Qualifiers.

faqs.q: Did Revenant Xspark change its BGMI roster too?
faqs.a: Yes, IGN India says the organisation also made major changes to its BGMI line-up. Returning player Tenzin "Shadow7" Kelsang is at the helm of that roster.
